column2: Like other parts of the country, the subproject area has a tropical monsoon climate

column1: with four seasons namely: the dry or winter season (December-February); the pre-monsoon hot season

column4: or rainy season (June-September) and the post–monsoon or autumn

column1: season (October-November). The annual average temperature of the district varies maximum 34.3°C
to minimum 12.7°C and the average annual rainfall of the district is recorded 2551 mm (BBS, 2011).
Humidity levels are consistently very high during the monsoon season, and drop significantly for a
relatively short period at the end of the dry season. Sunshine levels are low during the monsoon, but
from November to May are consistently high.
